note: TEST-A and TEST-C exist so fixtures can move. They are test-only rates and are not the uncurved fallback. Letters AA and A–G are recognised because docs/formats/shiplist.md already names them. Their per-letter rates stay unverified until playtest against Community Edition 2.670 (issue #37). A hull with no turn curve uses fallbackMaxYawPerTick. The sim emits turnModeUnverified once when that hull is spawned, then keeps speed and yaw. A hull that names a turn curve turns at that curve, and this fallback does not slow it down. H is the stationary token from the format spec.
fallbackNote: Uncurved yaw per tick, taken from the measured default row in turn-normal.json at speed 15. That row copies the F-CA points, and speed 15 is 46 angle units per tick (about 7.6 degrees per second). One value for every hull that has no curve, until a letter is set under measured.json turnYaw.measuredMaxYawPerTick. TEST-C stays 2000 and is not this number.
